simple.meaning: נֶפֶג (Nepheg) is a Hebrew word meaning “Nepheg , the name of two Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נֶפֶג (H5298) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 6:21, with occurrences in Exodus, 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֶפֶג (H5298) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נֶפֶג (H5298) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נֶפֶג (Nepheg) / H5298 is traced through Exodus 6:21, 2 Samuel 5:15, 1 Chronicles 3:7, 1 Chronicles 14:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
